task: Photorealistic interior rendering, three views of the same living room, consistent finishes and furniture across all views
style: High-end residential interior photography, warm natural light, Architectural Digest editorial quality, no CGI sheen, subtle film grain

room.description: Living room in a 1938 two-story bungalow, 21 feet 4 inches long (north-south) by 14 feet wide (east-west), 9 foot ceiling with simple crown molding
room.trim: Benjamin Moore Ivory White, satin, original 1930s window and door casings
room.floor: Natural white oak hardwood, matte finish, period inlaid dark walnut border running around the perimeter of the room
room.ceiling: Flat white plaster with recessed can lights dimmed low to about 25 percent, warm 2700K

architecture.west_wall: Fireplace centered on the wall. Vertical white oak slat surround from floor to a white oak floating mantel shelf, slats stop at the shelf, plain painted wall above. Handmade ivory tile with slight glaze variation around the firebox, ivory quartz slab hearth. One single double-hung window south of the fireplace and one connected double window north of the fireplace, both with ivory casings and woven wood roman shades
architecture.north_wall: Connected double window centered on the wall. Three white oak floating shelves on each side of the window, flanking it
architecture.east_wall: Long solid wall, no windows, single doorway at the far south end
architecture.south_wall: Small arched opening to the foyer on the west side, walnut mid-century credenza used as a bar on the east side

furniture.sofa_east: Greige upholstered sofa, straight track arms, tapered walnut legs, placed against the east wall facing the fireplace
furniture.sofa_north: Matching greige sofa in the same fabric at the north end of the room facing south, floated 30 inches off the north window
furniture.layout: The two sofas form an L. No sectional. The path from the foyer arch to the seating is open
furniture.corner_table: Small round walnut side table at the inside corner where the two sofas meet, with a ceramic table lamp in off-white
furniture.console: Narrow walnut console table, 13 inches deep, running the length of the north sofa directly behind it, with two matching small brass table lamps, a stack of books, and one ceramic object
furniture.coffee_table: Oval walnut mid-century coffee table, about 50 inches long, lower shelf, in front of the east sofa
furniture.fireplace_chair: Open-arm mid-century lounge chair, walnut frame, oatmeal upholstery, angled toward the fireplace in the northwest corner near the double window
furniture.ottoman: Rectangular upholstered ottoman in olive green boucle, 36 by 24 inches, between the fireplace chair and the coffee table
furniture.credenza_bar: Walnut mid-century credenza on the south wall with a turntable, a small brass dome lamp, and a curated bar of eight bottles and glassware
furniture.rug: Large 10 by 14 foot wool flatweave rug in oatmeal with a subtle olive and rust geometric pattern, no fringe, front legs of every seat resting on it
furniture.drapery: Floor to ceiling natural linen drapery panels on the north double window, mounted high and wide on a slim aged brass rod, panels stacked off the glass

lighting_layered.picture_light: Slim aged brass rechargeable picture light mounted on the wall above the mantel art, no visible cord, warm glow on the art
lighting_layered.lamps: Five lamps total at seated eye level all lit warm: two brass console lamps behind the north sofa, one ceramic lamp at the corner table, one brass floor lamp beside the fireplace chair, one brass dome lamp on the credenza bar
lighting_layered.ceiling_fixture: One semi-flush fixture centered over the seating area, 20 inch white glass drum with aged brass fitter, lit low
lighting_layered.fire: Small fire burning in the firebox
lighting_layered.mood: Late afternoon, low sun entering from the west windows, lamps on, cans dimmed, the room glows rather than being flatly lit

art.east_wall: One very large framed abstract painting, 72 inches wide by 48 inches tall, loose gestural brushwork in rust, olive, charcoal, and cream on a warm white ground, thin black floater frame, centered over the east sofa with the bottom edge 9 inches above the sofa back. This is the largest object in the room
art.mantel: Large framed sepia-toned landscape photograph of rolling California hills, 46 inches wide, light oak frame, centered above the mantel shelf, lit by the picture light
art.bar_wall: One vintage cocktail chart print in a dark walnut frame above the credenza, nothing else on that wall
art.mantel_shelf: Nearly bare, one small ceramic vessel placed off center
art.shelves: Floating shelves styled sparsely, 60 percent books with spines in muted tones, 40 percent objects, a trailing pothos on an upper shelf, one small leaning framed sketch

plants.tall: Floor to ceiling Ficus Audrey, about 8 feet tall, in a matte off-white cylinder planter, placed in the northwest corner at the west end of the console behind the north sofa
plants.mid: Medium potted plant in a matte black ceramic pot on the credenza bar
plants.trailing: Pothos trailing from an upper floating shelf

accessories.pillows: Each sofa has three pillows: one rust velvet, one olive linen, one cream textured. No more than three per sofa
accessories.throw: One chunky oatmeal wool throw folded over the arm of the east sofa
accessories.hearth: Blackened steel fireplace tool set and a leather firewood carrier with split oak beside the hearth
accessories.coffee_table_styling: Two stacked books, a small brass bowl, a low ceramic vase with a few dried branches

color_palette.base: Accessible Beige walls, ivory trim, natural white oak, greige upholstery, walnut furniture
color_palette.accents: Rust, olive green, and charcoal, each repeated at least three times across pillows, rug, ottoman, and art
color_palette.metals: Aged brass for all lamps and the picture light, blackened steel at the hearth only

views.name: View A, toward the fireplace
views.camera: Standing at the east wall, 5 foot height, 24mm lens, looking west across the coffee table at the fireplace. Both windows flanking the fireplace are visible, the single window to the left (south) and the double window to the right (north). The north sofa, console, lamps, and the tall plant are visible on the right edge of frame

views.name: View B, toward the south wall
views.camera: Standing near the north window, 5 foot height, 24mm lens, looking south. The east sofa and large abstract painting are on the left, the credenza bar and foyer arch are ahead, the fireplace and slat surround are on the right

views.name: View C, toward the north wall
views.camera: Standing just inside the foyer arch, 5 foot height, 24mm lens, looking north down the length of the room. Fireplace on the left, east sofa and large painting on the right, north sofa with console, drapery, lamps, and tall plant at the far end

negative_prompt: No flat uniform lighting, no sectional sofa, no fringe on rug, no fake-looking olive tree, no visible cords, no gallery wall clusters, no clutter on the mantel, no people, no text artifacts, no lens distortion, no oversaturated colors, no missing windows on the fireplace wall
